//: 81mm HE mortar shell for the M252. Heavier and substantially more destructive than the 60mm M720.
description: A large 81mm high-explosive mortar shell with a tapered nose and fin-stabilized base.  Heavier and far more destructive than a 60mm round, it is fired from a medium mortar against troops, structures, and light vehicles at long range.

//: Mk 3 HEDP rocket for the Mk 153 SMAW. Dual-purpose: shaped charge for light armor/bunkers plus blast/frag.
description: An 83mm High-Explosive Dual-Purpose rocket for the SMAW.  A shaped charge punches through a bunker wall or light armor, while the follow-through blast and fragmentation clear whatever is behind it.

//: Fire-and-forget top-attack ATGM missile. Tandem HEAT, devastating against armor.
description: An FGM-148 Javelin missile, a fire-and-forget anti-tank guided munition.  Its tandem shaped-charge warhead and top-attack flight profile gut even heavy armor from above.  Once launched it guides itself, freeing the gunner to move.
